newsitem.title: UK: New UK charter airline to launch Lanzarote service.
newsitem.headline: New UK charter airline to launch Lanzarote service.

text.p: A new British charter holiday airline, Flying Colours, will begin operations with a Boeing 757-200 with a flight from Manchester to Lanzarote in the Canary Islands on March 6, a spokesman said.

The airline, part of the Flying Colours Leisure Group, will operate four brand-new leased 757-200s including one extended range version of the 757 flying out of Gatwick, Manchester and Glasgow to Orlando in Florida, he added.
"There are no plans at present to carry cargo although it may be looked at in the future, possibly on the Orlando route," he said.
Other flights will be to the Canary Islands, as well as Mediterranean destinations including Spain, the Greek islands and Turkey, he added,
The first flight from Gatwick will be on April 28 to Barcelona and all of the 235 seat passenger planes will be in service by early May.
Flying Colours is also acquiring an Airbus A320 to operate out of Glasgow between May and October on 14 routes to south European destinations, while one 757 will be based at Gatwick.
